name: R108-torment-choice-band-explosion
why: Challenge 7, trainer 200. Player Mr. Mime (572, faster) Torments the opponent's Choice Band Granbull (664) on turn 1 and is knocked out by the locked move; Weezing (597) comes in and on turn 2 Explodes before Granbull, which has no usable move (its locked move is tormented) and is KO'd by the Explosion too: the cancelled forced Struggle of a fainted second mover.
